headline: Woman tied to electric pole and beaten in Shariatpur over money dispute
summary: A 37-year-old woman was assaulted, had her hair chopped off, and was tied to a pole with a garland of shoes around her neck in Shariatpur Sadar.
details: A group of women allegedly tied a 37-year-old woman, Moli Begum, to an electric pole and assaulted her in Shariatpur Sadar upazila this morning. The incident occurred around 11:00 am over a longstanding financial dispute involving borrowing and lending money.
caption:
Tied to a pole, hair chopped off, and a garland of shoes around her neck—a woman was publicly humiliated in Shariatpur.

A group of women allegedly tied a 37-year-old woman, Moli Begum, to an electric pole and assaulted her in Shariatpur Sadar upazila this morning. The incident occurred around 11:00 am over a longstanding financial dispute involving borrowing and lending money.

headline_marked: 30 injured as [[clash erupts over lost luggage]] of Hajj pilgrim in Brahmanbaria
headline: 30 injured as clash erupts over lost luggage of Hajj pilgrim in Brahmanbaria
summary: A dispute over a missing bag belonging to a Hajj pilgrim escalated into a violent confrontation between two groups in Kasba Upazila.
details: At least 30 people were injured during a clash between two groups in the Kasba Upazila of Brahmanbaria.
The violence was triggered by a dispute regarding the lost luggage of a Hajj pilgrim.
The confrontation escalated quickly, leading to multiple injuries among the participants from both sides.
